lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular spots are arranged in distinct vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with the highest-intensity maxima located in the mid-lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with light-reflecting dorsal edges and shadowed ventral edges.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A deep, smooth, semi-circular indentation is present on the posterior trailing edge of the pectoral fin, indicating significant tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: A small, light-colored teleost (remora) is visible attached to or swimming closely alongside the ventral region near the pectoral fin base.
